title: Az Országgyűlés és a törvényhozó hatalom (The National Assembly & Legislative Authority)
grammar: Institutional Governance, Separation of Powers & Public Law in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say how many members the Hungarian National Assembly has and for how many years they are elected.
I can say what the National Assembly does: it makes laws, adopts the budget and approves international treaties.
I can say that the National Assembly has one chamber and is elected by a mixed system.
I can read a short text about the Parliament and its members.
